cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Which cities to pull incidents from. Each city is its police department's official open-data feed.

crimeType.title: Crime type contains
crimeType.description: Only incidents whose offense category or description contains this text ("ASSAULT", "BURGLARY", "THEFT"). Case-insensitive. Leave empty for all incidents.

sinceDays.title: Occurred within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only incidents that occurred in the last N days. Cities publish with a lag: Seattle/SF/Dallas run a day or two behind, Chicago and Austin about a week, and NYC refreshes quarterly (use 90+ days there).

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new incidents only
newOnly.description: Remember incidents already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a schedule for a neighborhood or citywide new-incident feed - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxPerCity.title: Incidents per city
maxPerCity.description: How many incidents to return per city, newest first.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
